description: Sponsored by Rep. Pam Marsh, D-Ashland, at Kotek’s request, the approximately 4,800-bed system is the culmination of five years of shelter building work by the state. The beds are available in 138 shelters scattered throughout Oregon in nearly every county.
title: Oregon’s new statewide shelter system has 4,800 beds; here’s a map - REPRESENTATIVE PAM MARSH
